meaning:
1) (Piel) to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law
1a) the duty due to a brother who died childless - to marry his widow and have a son for his name
glosses: perform your duty as her brother-in-law
fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law for her

renderings.bsb: Perform your duty as her brother-in-law
fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law for her

elsewhere.note: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
